scope: isolated PostgreSQL schema; real HTTP and private Blob; local SMTP capture

checks.name: isolated schema migrations and empty account boundary
isolated HTTP server and local-only mail transport
candidate signup, captured confirmation and blocked unverified login
employer confirmation stays separate from company approval
private CV, license and provisional uploads with owner and cross-account reads
licensed, seeking and in-training profiles persist through HTTP
real-database candidate review compare-and-set permits only one competing decision
real-database audit failure rolls back candidate approval
company and vacancy moderation with stage-aware discovery
selected document submissions, duplicates and scoped employer access
unrelated employer and candidate IDs cannot borrow application access
interview persists, notifies the candidate and delivers to captured SMTP
closure preserves history; withdrawal removes only its application grant
replacement never shares the new file and removes the previous private object
last withdrawal revokes access; private deletion removes owner access and stored object
suspension blocks existing employer sessions, submissions and document reads
logout revokes the actual persisted session
no synthetic accounts were written to the normal schema
direct private Blob URL denies anonymous access
